elements.description:
A design-system inspector over a live page – components outlined with a card of their name, path and links, a
breakpoint ruler, and flex and grid containers outlined and listed; ⌘⇧L to turn it on.

properties.name: active
properties.description: Whether it's on. Changed by the user unless a tc-active-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: hotkey
properties.description: Turns it on and off from anywhere ("mod+shift+l" is ⌘⇧L on Apple keyboards, Ctrl Shift L elsewhere); false turns it off

properties.name: root
properties.description: Where to look; the whole page by default

properties.name: components
properties.description: Descriptions and links by component name: the data-ds-component value, or the element's name in words

properties.name: describe
properties.description: Describes an element itself; return null to leave it to the defaults

properties.name: breakpoints
properties.default: [ { id: "sm", label: "Small", min: 640 }, { id: "md", label: "Medium", min: 768 }, { id: "lg", label: "Large", min: 1024 }, { id: "xl", label: "Extra large", min: 1280 }, { id: "2xl", label: "2× large", min: 1536 }, ]
properties.description: The breakpoints the ruler and the panel show

properties.name: showComponents
properties.description: Outline components. Switched by the user unless tc-feature-change is prevented

properties.name: showRuler
properties.description: Show the breakpoint ruler. Switched by the user unless tc-feature-change is prevented

properties.name: showLayouts
properties.description: Outline and list flex and grid containers. Switched by the user unless tc-feature-change is prevented

properties.name: floating
properties.description: The panel floats at the window's corner while on; off, it's a card in the page

properties.name: launcher
properties.description: Floating and off: show a small button that turns it on

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-active-change
events.description: Turned on or off ({ active }: LoupeActiveChange), by the hotkey, Escape, Close or the start button; cancelable – prevented, `active` stays as it was

events.name: tc-feature-change
events.description: Components, the ruler or layouts were switched ({ feature, on }: LoupeFeatureChange); cancelable – prevented, the switch stays

events.name: tc-select
events.description: A component was picked in the panel ({ element, info }: LoupeSelect)

functions.name: breakpointApplies
functions.description: Whether a breakpoint applies at this width

functions.name: breakpointRange
functions.description: A breakpoint's range in words: "≥ 640 px", "≤ 767 px", "640–1023 px"

props.name: active
props.description: Whether it's on – controlled when given

props.name: defaultActive
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled Loupe starts on

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Turned on or off (the hotkey, Escape, Close, the start button)

props.name: defaultShowComponents
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled Loupe starts outlining components (default true)

props.name: showRuler
props.description: Show the breakpoint ruler – controlled when given

props.name: defaultShowRuler
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled Loupe starts with the ruler (default true)

props.name: showLayouts
props.description: Outline and list flex and grid containers – controlled when given

props.name: defaultShowLayouts
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled Loupe starts with layouts (default false)

props.name: onFeatureChange
props.description: Components, the ruler or layouts were switched; `event.preventDefault()` keeps the switch as it was

props.name: onComponentSelect
props.description: A component was picked in the panel

changelog: **Loupe** (`tc-loupe`) – remade from cautious-lamp's LoupeTool. ⌘⇧L outlines the page's components (`data-ds-component` and the library's own elements) with a card of name, path, size, look and docs / source / design links; a ruler marks the breakpoints and the window's width; flex and grid containers are outlined and listed. Unlike the original, the page keeps scrolling and working underneath, outlines follow scrolling, resizing and DOM changes (no polling), the overlay sits in the top layer so transformed or contained ancestors can't shift it, and everything is reachable from keyboard lists in the panel. Kept out of generative UI.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: backdrop-filter
features.without: What's behind a translucent surface isn't blurred; the surface keeps its fill.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
